name: Mining Simulator
seoDescription: Mining Simulator codes unlock rare eggs, crates, tokens, and coins that help players upgrade gear and collect pets for better mining runs.
introMd: Mining Simulator lets you dig through different worlds to find coins, eggs, hats, and crates. Using Mining Simulator codes gives you free items like rare eggs and tokens that you can’t easily get by just playing. These codes drop rewards that help you unlock pets, hats, and upgrades faster, making your mining runs more fun and rewarding.
redeemMd:
## How to Redeem Mining Simulator Codes
You don’t need any special level or condition to redeem codes in Mining Simulator. Just follow these simple steps:
1. [[roblox_link|Launch Mining Simulator]].
2. Look for the bird icon with the word Codes on the left side of your screen.
3. Click on the Codes icon to open the code redemption window.
4. Copy a valid code exactly as it appears.
5. Paste the code into the text box labeled Code Here.
6. Press the green Enter button to redeem your reward.
7. Check your inventory for crates or items you received from the code.
rewardsMd:
## What Rewards You Normally Get?
Mining Simulator codes mostly grant crates, eggs, tokens, coins, and special textures. Each type has a unique use in the game:

| Reward Type       | Description                                                                                  |
|-------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Eggs              | Random pets that can boost mining speed or coin gain. Legendary and unique eggs are rare.    |
| Crates            | Contain hats, accessories, or skins that improve mining abilities or provide cosmetic flair.|
| Tokens            | Currency used to buy limited event items and gear.                                          |
| Coins             | Basic currency for upgrading pickaxes and storage space.                                    |
| Textures          | Special skins for your pickaxe that change its appearance without affecting stats.           |

These rewards add variety and strategic options to your mining experience, letting you customize your setup and collect rare pets or hats.
troubleshootMd:
## Why Codes Might Not Work
Codes may fail if you enter them with extra spaces or incorrect characters. Always copy and paste codes directly to avoid typos. Mining Simulator does not require any level or progress to redeem codes, so no special conditions block code use.
